provenance: Derived from three Dante captures of one BMA360 tile on 2026-11-03 (stock Brooklyn-3 firmware, stock board configuration), UDP port 4321, 393-byte packets: 1-byte type 0x02, 4-byte seconds, 4-byte frame, 16 frames x 8 channels x signed 24-bit big-endian. Packets de-duplicated by (seconds, frame) and ordered. Only levels, spectra and correlations are stored; no audio.
